Definitions.Definition:
-- ============================================= -- Author: <Author,,Name> -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description: <Description,,> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_Update_isDepended] @T_ID int, @Tr_ID int = NULL, @Pr_ID int = NULL, @Pay_ID int = 1 AS
declare @BS_Type INT,@i int,@IM_ID int,@j int,@NewSale numeric(18, 2) = NULL,@NewSaleByOne NUMERIC(18,3),@Cost numeric(18, 2), @PreQty numeric(18,2),@U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@AG_ID int,@Pure NUMERIC(18,3),@User_ID int,@D_Valid NVARCHAR(50),@ST_T_ID int,@ST_ID int ,@ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,2),@ST_F int,@ST_T int,@Pch_ID int,@Pch_ID_2 Nvarchar(25),@Price NUMERIC(18,2),@PrevCost NUMERIC(18,2),@Invoice_Type int ,@AG_DATE DATETIME , @Min_SP NUMERIC(18,2),@Min_SP_ByOne NUMERIC(18,2),@Receipt_Title Nvarchar(2000)
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
SELECT @BS_Type = BsType_ID , @Invoice_Type=Invoice_Type , @AG_DATE=Date , @AG_ID = AG_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID Update Agents_Balance_MV SET isDepended=1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
exec [Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total] @T_ID
IF @BS_Type = 1 BEGIN UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 1 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID EXEC [SB_Contents_Structers_insert] @T_ID GOTO ESC END
IF @BS_Type = 7 -- Pch OR Invoice BEGIN
SELECT @Pure = PURE , @User_ID = User_ID , @Pch_ID = Pch_ID , @Pch_ID_2 = Pch_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV_V WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
IF (SELECT is_Auto_Pied FROM Agents WHERE AG_ID = @AG_ID) = 1 BEGIN
UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Receipt_Title = @Pch_ID WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
SET @Receipt_Title = 'فاتورة مشتريات : ' + @Pch_ID_2 EXEC [Agents_BalanceMV_insert_RCT] 0, @AG_DATE, 0,--@Receipt_Num @AG_ID, @Pr_ID, @T_ID,--@Receipt_Tran_ID '',--@ReferNum @Receipt_Title, @Pure,--@Pure NULL,--@About 4,--@BsType_ID @User_ID , @Tr_ID, '',--BANK_NAME '',--CHECK_NUMBER @Pay_ID --*************************************** END
END
ELSE IF @BS_Type = 8 --IM_EX BEGIN UPDATE IMEX_Details SET isDepended = 1 where IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID END
------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ELSE IF @BS_Type = 10 --SB_RTN BEGIN SELECT @Pure = PURE , @User_ID = User_ID , @Pch_ID_2 = SRtn_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV_V WHERE T_ID = @T_ID UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Receipt_Title = @Pch_ID_2 ,DATE = GETDATE() WHERE T_ID = @T_ID UPDATE Rtn_Contents SET isDepended = 1 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID EXEC Rtn_Contents_UPDATE_DEPENDED @T_ID
IF (SELECT is_Auto_Pied FROM Agents WHERE AG_ID = @AG_ID) = 1 BEGIN
SET @Receipt_Title = ' إرجاع مبيعات '+@Pch_ID_2 EXEC [Agents_BalanceMV_insert_RCT] 0, @AG_DATE, 0,--@Receipt_Num @AG_ID, @Pr_ID, @T_ID,--@Receipt_Tran_ID '',--@ReferNum @Receipt_Title, @Pure,--@Pure NULL,--@About 4,--@BsType_ID @User_ID , @Tr_ID, '',--BANK_NAME '',--CHECK_NUMBER @Pay_ID
END END ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ELSE IF @BS_Type = 11 --PCH_RTN BEGIN SELECT @Pure = PURE , @User_ID = User_ID , @Pch_ID_2 = PRtn_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV_V WHERE T_ID = @T_ID UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Receipt_Title = @Pch_ID_2 ,DATE = GETDATE() WHERE T_ID = @T_ID UPDATE Rtn_Contents SET isDepended = 1 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID
IF (SELECT is_Auto_Pied FROM Agents WHERE AG_ID = @AG_ID) = 1 BEGIN
SET @Receipt_Title = ' إرجاع مشتريات '+@Pch_ID_2 EXEC [Agents_BalanceMV_insert_RCT] 0, @AG_DATE, 0,--@Receipt_Num @AG_ID, @Pr_ID, @T_ID,--@Receipt_Tran_ID '',--@ReferNum @Receipt_Title, @Pure,--@Pure NULL,--@About 3,--@BsType_ID @User_ID , @Tr_ID, '',--BANK_NAME '',--CHECK_NUMBER @Pay_ID
END END --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ELSE IF @BS_Type = 12 --Store_Trans BEGIN --UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET ST_is_Trans = 0 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID UPDATE Store_Trans_Details SET isDepended = 1 where B_T_ID = @T_ID END
IF @BS_Type = 2 -- EXP_Details BEGIN
UPDATE EXP_Details SET isDepended = 1 where IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID IF (SELECT is_Auto_Pied FROM Agents WHERE AG_ID = @AG_ID) = 1 BEGIN SELECT @Pure = PURE , @User_ID = User_ID , @Pch_ID = EXP_ID , @Pch_ID_2 = EXP_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV_V WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
SET @Receipt_Title = 'فاتورة مصروفات رقم : '+@Pch_ID_2 EXEC [Agents_BalanceMV_insert_RCT] 0, @AG_DATE, 0,--@Receipt_Num @AG_ID, @Pr_ID, @T_ID,--@Receipt_Tran_ID '',--@ReferNum @Receipt_Title, @Pure,--@Pure NULL,--@About 4,--@BsType_ID @User_ID , @Tr_ID, '',--BANK_NAME '',--CHECK_NUMBER @Pay_ID
END
END
IF @BS_Type = 13 OR @BS_Type = 18 -- FRM_ITEM BEGIN
UPDATE FRM_Details SET isDepended = 1 where FRM_T_ID = @T_ID
IF @BS_Type = 18 BEGIN UPDATE FRM_Contents_Details SET isDepended = 1 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID END
SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Details WHERE FRM_T_ID = @T_ID WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
SELECT @IM_ID=IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID = ST_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY,@NewSale = NewSale,@NewSaleByOne=NewSaleByOne,@Cost = Price,@U_Cargo=U_Cargo ,@Min_SP = Min_SP , @Min_SP_ByOne =Min_SP_ByOne FROM FRM_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
SELECT @PreQty = (ISNULL(SUM(ST_QTY),0) - @ST_QTY) FROM ST_Balance WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID
IF @PreQty > 0 BEGIN SELECT @PrevCost = Cost From IM_Menu WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID UPDATE IM_Menu SET Cost = ( (@PrevCost * @PreQty) + ( (@Cost/@U_Cargo) * @ST_QTY ) ) / ( @PreQty + @ST_QTY ) WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE IM_Menu SET Cost = (@Cost/@U_Cargo) WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID END
IF @NewSale is Not NULL BEGIN DECLARE @Tmp_Cargo2 Numeric(18,2) SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Units WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID WHILE @j is Not NULL BEGIN SELECT @Tmp_Cargo2 = U_Cargo FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_IM_ID = @j UPDATE IM_Units SET Price = (@NewSale/@U_Cargo) * @Tmp_Cargo2 WHERE U_IM_ID = @j
SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Units WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_IM_ID > @j END END ---------------------------------------------------------- IF @NewSaleByOne is Not NULL BEGIN SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID And U_Cargo = 1 WHILE @j is Not NULL BEGIN UPDATE IM_Units SET Price = @NewSaleByOne WHERE U_IM_ID = @j SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_Cargo = 1 AND U_IM_ID > @j END END
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- IF @Min_SP is Not NULL BEGIN SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Units WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID WHILE @j is Not NULL BEGIN SELECT @Tmp_Cargo2 = U_Cargo FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_IM_ID = @j UPDATE IM_Units SET Min_SP = (@Min_SP/@U_Cargo) * @Tmp_Cargo2 WHERE U_IM_ID = @j
SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Units WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_IM_ID > @j END END
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @Min_SP_ByOne is Not NULL BEGIN SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID And U_Cargo = 1 WHILE @j is Not NULL BEGIN UPDATE IM_Units SET Min_SP = @Min_SP_ByOne WHERE U_IM_ID = @j SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_Cargo = 1 AND U_IM_ID > @j END END
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Details WHERE FRM_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i END
--2++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
--UPDATE FRM_Contents_Details SET isDepended = 1 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Contents_Details WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID=IM_ID,@D_Valid='',@ST_ID = ST_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY,@U_Cargo=U_Cargo --FROM FRM_Contents_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
--IF @NewSale is Not NULL BEGIN --DECLARE @Tmp_Cargo3 Numeric(18,2) --SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Units WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID --WHILE @j is Not NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @Tmp_Cargo3 = U_Cargo FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_IM_ID = @j --UPDATE IM_Units SET Price = (@NewSale/@U_Cargo) * @Tmp_Cargo3 WHERE U_IM_ID = @j
--SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Units WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_IM_ID > @j --END --END ------------------------------------------------------------ --IF @NewSaleByOne is Not NULL BEGIN --SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID And U_Cargo = 1 --WHILE @j is Not NULL --BEGIN -- UPDATE IM_Units SET Price = @NewSaleByOne WHERE U_IM_ID = @j --SELECT @j = min(U_IM_ID) From IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_Cargo = 1 AND U_IM_ID > @j --END --END ------------------------------------------------------------
----EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Contents_Details WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END
END ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 16 -- ViewBill BEGIN UPDATE ViewBill_Contents SET isDepended = 1 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID END
ELSE IF @BS_Type = 17 -- InSale BEGIN UPDATE InSale_Details SET isDepended = 1 where InSale_T_ID = @T_ID END
ESC:
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 print 'DB ERROR ! __ AG_Balance_Update_isDepended' ROLLBACK END CATCH

Definitions.Definition:
-- ============================================= -- Author: <Author,,Name> -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description: <Description,,> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update] @B_T_ID int, @Bs_Type INT AS DECLARE @TOTAL numeric(18,3),@Discount numeric(18,3) BEGIN
SELECT @Discount = ISNULL(Discount,0) FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID
IF @Bs_Type = 1 BEGIN
SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @B_T_ID AND isDepended = 1 --IF @TOTAL IS NULL BEGIN SET @TOTAL = 0 END --UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Debit = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)),Total = @TOTAL,Pure = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)) WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID --EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @B_T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
END ELSE IF @Bs_Type = 7 BEGIN
SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(Total),0) FROM Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @B_T_ID AND isDepended = 1 --IF @TOTAL IS NULL BEGIN SET @TOTAL = 0 END --Update Agents_Balance_MV SET Credit = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)),Total = @TOTAL ,Pure = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)) WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID --EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @B_T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
END ELSE IF @Bs_Type = 2 BEGIN
SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(Total),0) FROM EXP_Details WHERE IMEX_T_ID = @B_T_ID AND isDepended = 1 --IF @TOTAL IS NULL BEGIN SET @TOTAL = 0 END --Update Agents_Balance_MV SET Credit = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)),Total = @TOTAL ,Pure = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)) WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID
END
EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @B_T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
END

/* المرحلة النهائية لفصل مسؤولية حساب الفاتورة عن تسوية الدفع.
هذا الإجراء لا يعدل: dbo.Agents_Balance_MV_RCT dbo.Treasury_Balance_MV
تبقى السندات مجمدة أثناء تعديل الأصناف، وتعالج الفروق لاحقًا بواسطة إجراء تسوية مستقل يسجل تحصيلًا أو استردادًا جديدًا. */ CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_Update_Total] @T_ID INT, @Total MONEY, @Disc MONEY = 0 AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Agents_Balance_MV] WHERE T_ID = @T_ID ) RAISERROR(N'لم يتم العثور على المعاملة المطلوب إعادة حسابها.', 16, 1)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Deliver_Order] @T_ID int, @Order_isDeleverd bit, @User_ID INT, @Pr_ID INT, @Tr_ID INT
AS BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
declare @TRMV_T_ID INT,@B_Type INT ,@Pied FLOAT,@i int,@Receipt_Title NVARCHAR(2500), @NEW_T_ID INT,@Bill_Num INT,@Receipt_Num INT,@AG_ID INT , @SB_ID nvarchar(25) , @ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,2),@U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@U_ID INT,@IM_ID INT,@ST_ID INT,@D_Vaild NVARCHAR(50)
Update Agents_Balance_MV SET Order_isDeleverd = @Order_isDeleverd WHERE T_ID = @T_ID UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 1 ,Date = GETDATE() WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID EXEC AG_Balance_Update_isDepended @T_ID
--SELECT @i = MIN(T_ID) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @U_Cargo = U_Cargo ,@IM_ID=IM_ID, @ST_ID=ST_ID,@D_Vaild=D_Vaild,@ST_QTY =ST_QTY FROM SB_Contents where T_ID = @i --EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Vaild,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = MIN(T_ID) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END

UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET isPied = 1 , Pure = @Pied , Receipt_Title = 'فاتورة مبيعات : ' + @SB_ID WHERE T_ID = @T_ID

--Insert Into Treasury_Balance_MV --(AGBalance_T_ID,Tran_ID,date,Tr_ID,notice_move,Bank_Name,CheckNum,Debit,Credit,Balance, --Tr_Type_ID,isTran_From,isTran_To,User_ID,isVoid) --Values (@NEW_T_ID,NULL,GETDATE(),@Tr_ID,'فاتورة مبيعات : ' + @SB_ID,NULL,NULL,@Pied,NULL,NULL,2,NULL,NULL,@User_ID,0) --SELECT @TRMV_T_ID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
SET @Receipt_Title = 'فاتورة مبيعات : ' + @SB_ID EXEC [Agents_BalanceMV_insert_RCT] 0, GETDATE, 0,--@Receipt_Num @AG_ID, @Pr_ID, @T_ID,--@Receipt_Tran_ID '',--@ReferNum @Receipt_Title, @Pied,--@Pure NULL,--@About 3,--@BsType_ID @User_ID , @Tr_ID, '',--BANK_NAME ''--CHECK_NUMBER
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_ConfermBill] @T_ID int, @TOTAL FLOAT, @Discount FLOAT, @Pure FLOAT, @Pied FLOAT = NULL, @AGType_ID INT, @Point_Inc FLOAT = NULL, @Points_Sale FLOAT = NULL, @Deliver_date NVARCHAR(150) = NULL, @Order_isDeleverd Bit = NULL, @isCostmerScreen Bit = NULL, @Tr_ID INT, @Pr_ID INT, @TB_ID int = NULL, @User_ID int = NULL, @Pay_ID int = 1 AS declare @B_Type INT , @TB_ORDER_CODE NVARCHAR(100) = NULL, @TB_NAME NVARCHAR(100) = NULL , @Bill_Num INT,@AG_ID INT , @SB_ID nvarchar(25) , @Receipt_Title NVARCHAR(500) ,@DATE DATETIME ,@isPied INT = 0
SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY NORMAL
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION --BEGIN
SELECT @AG_ID = AG_ID,@B_Type = S_Bills_Type , @Bill_Num = S_Bill_Pr_ID ,@isPied = isPied , @SB_ID=SB_ID ,@DATE = GETDATE() FROM SB_Info_V WHERE T_ID = @T_ID --IF @B_Type <> 3 BEGIN EXEC AG_Balance_Update_isDepended @T_ID END
EXEC [SB_Contents_Structers_insert] @T_ID
IF @TB_ID IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT @TB_ORDER_CODE = TB_ORDER_CODE , @TB_NAME = T_NAME FROM Tables WHERE TB_ID = @TB_ID SET @TB_NAME = ' جزء من طاولة ' + @TB_NAME Update Agents_Balance_MV SET About = @TB_NAME WHERE T_ID = @T_ID END
Update Agents_Balance_MV SET isDepended = 1 , Receipt_Title = @SB_ID , Total = @TOTAL,Discount = @Discount, SB_isOpen = 0 ,isPause = NULL ,Deliver_date= @Deliver_date, Order_isDeleverd=@Order_isDeleverd , TB_ORDER_CODE = @TB_ORDER_CODE , Table_ID = @TB_ID WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
UPDATE Periods SET AG_Counter += 1 WHERE Pr_ID = @Pr_ID
IF ( (SELECT is_Auto_Pied FROM Agents WHERE AG_ID = @AG_ID) = 1 ) OR ( @AGType_ID IN (3,5)) BEGIN SET @Pied= @Pure end
IF @Pied > 0 AND @isPied = 0 BEGIN --UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Pied = @Pied ,@Pure = @Pied, isPied = 1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
SELECT @Receipt_Title = 'فاتورة مبيعات : ' + @SB_ID SET @Pure = @Pied -----------------------------------------------------------------------<INSERT RCT>
EXEC [Agents_BalanceMV_insert_RCT] 0, @DATE, 0,--@Receipt_Num @AG_ID, @Pr_ID, @T_ID,--@Receipt_Tran_ID NULL,--@ReferNum @Receipt_Title, @Pure,--@Pure NULL,--@About 3,--@BsType_ID @User_ID , @Tr_ID, '',--BANK_NAME '',--CHECK_NUMBER @Pay_ID -----------------------------------------------------------------------</INSERT RCT>
--EXEC @Receipt_Num = AG_BalanceMV_GetMaxRecepitNum
--INSERT INTO Agents_Balance_MV --(Receipt_Tran_ID,AG_ID,Receipt_Num,S_Bill_Pr_ID,Pr_ID,Date,BsType_ID,Receipt_Title,Credit,SB_isOpen,isDepended,User_ID) --VALUES (@T_ID,@AG_ID,@Receipt_Num,@Bill_Num,@Pr_ID,GETDATE(),3,'فاتورة مبيعات : ' + @SB_ID,@Pied,0,1,@User_ID) --SELECT @NEW_T_ID = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Insert Into Treasury_Balance_MV --(AGBalance_T_ID,Tran_ID,date,Tr_ID,notice_move,Bank_Name,CheckNum,Debit,Credit,Balance, --Tr_Type_ID,isTran_From,isTran_To,User_ID,isVoid) --Values (@NEW_T_ID,NULL,GETDATE(),@Tr_ID,'فاتورة مبيعات : ' + @SB_ID,NULL,NULL,@Pied,NULL,NULL,2,NULL,NULL,@User_ID,0) --SELECT @TRMV_T_ID = SCOPE_IDENTITY(); --END ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- END
--IF @AGType_ID = 4 --BEGIN --IF @Pure >= @Points_Sale --BEGIN
--EXEC @Receipt_Num = AG_BalanceMV_GetMaxRecepitNum --INSERT INTO Agents_Balance_MV --(Receipt_Tran_ID,AG_ID,Receipt_Num,S_Bill_Pr_ID,Pr_ID,Date,Receipt_Title,BsType_ID,Credit,SB_isOpen,isDepended,User_ID) --VALUES (@T_ID,@AG_ID,@Receipt_Num,@Bill_Num,@Pr_ID,GETDATE(),'نقاط',3,@Point_Inc ,0,1,@User_ID) --SELECT @NEW_T_ID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
--Insert Into Treasury_Balance_MV --(AGBalance_T_ID,Tran_ID,date,Tr_ID,notice_move,Bank_Name,CheckNum,Debit,Credit,Balance, --Tr_Type_ID,isTran_From,isTran_To,User_ID,isVoid) --Values (@NEW_T_ID,NULL,GETDATE(),@Tr_ID,'نقاط مظافة',NULL,NULL,@Point_Inc,NULL,NULL,2,NULL,NULL,@User_ID,1) --SELECT @TRMV_T_ID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
--END --END ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
--************************************** IF @isCostmerScreen = 1 BEGIN Insert Into Costmer_Screen(T_ID,Bill_Num,isawait,isShowed,TimeStart) Values (@T_ID,@Bill_Num,1,1,GetDate()) END --**************************************
IF @TB_ID IS NOT NULL BEGIN Update Agents_Balance_MV SET TB_ORDER_CODE = (SELECT TB_ORDER_CODE FROM Tables WHERE TB_ID = @TB_ID) WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
--IF (SELECT COUNT(*) AS S from Tables_NotPied_V where Table_ID = @TB_ID) = 0 --BEGIN --UPDATE Tables SET isbusy = 0 WHERE TB_ID = @TB_ID --END
END
IF (SELECT TB_Auto_Print FROM Sys_Features WHERE T_ID = (SELECT T_ID FROM Sys_Model)) = 1 BEGIN INSERT INTO TB_AutoPrint_tmp (T_ID) VALUES(@T_ID) END
exec Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @T_ID

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_Contents_Change_IM_Qty] @T_ID int, @Def int, @On_Update Bit AS
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
DECLARE @U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@IM_ID INT,@ST_ID INT,@D_Vaild NVARCHAR(50),@ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,3),@SB_T_ID INT,@AG_ID INT , @Cur_QTY FLOAT
SELECT @U_Cargo = U_Cargo ,@IM_ID=IM_ID, @ST_ID=ST_ID,@D_Vaild=D_Vaild ,@SB_T_ID = Bill_T_ID ,@Cur_QTY = QTY FROM SB_Contents where T_ID = @T_ID
IF (@Cur_QTY + @Def) >= 1 BEGIN UPDATE SB_Contents SET QTY = QTY + @Def , T_Price = (Price * (QTY + @Def)) , ST_QTY = (QTY + @Def) * U_Cargo where T_ID = @T_ID END
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
IF (SELECT ISNULL(S_Bills_Type,1) FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID) <> 3 -- SURE That the bill is not order BEGIN
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN EXEC [SB_Contents_Structers_Recount_One] @T_ID END
IF @Def = 1 BEGIN EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Vaild,@U_Cargo END ELSE BEGIN EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Vaild,@U_Cargo END
END
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 raiserror('[SB_Contents_Change_IM_Qty]',16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_Contents_INSERT] @SB_T_ID int, @IM_ID int, @D_Vaild DATE = NULL, @QYT float = 1, @ST_ID int, @U_IM_ID int, @On_Update Bit, @Barcode NVARCHAR(50), @IM_Price FLOAT = NULL, @SALES_TYPES INT = 0 AS DECLARE @T_ID int,@Price FLOAT ,@T_Price FLOAT,@U_ID int, @ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,2),@U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@Current_QTY Float ,@Cost Float,@Valid_ST NVARCHAR(50),@Total Numeric(18,3),@Bercent NUMERIC(18,2),@NOTES NVARCHAR(200),@AG_ID int,@OFFER_PRICE Float ,@Price_2 FLOAT ,@Price_3 FLOAT, @is_By_Min_SP int = 0 , @is_By_Min_SP_2 int = 0
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
SET @Valid_ST = @D_Vaild IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST ='' END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @Current_QTY = ISNULL(SUM(QTY),0) FROM ST_Balance_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID IF @Current_QTY <= 0 BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = (SELECT Top 1 D_Vaild FROM SB_Contents WHERE ST_ID = @ST_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID ORDER BY T_ID DESC) END --IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = '01-01-1900' END END
IF @U_IM_ID = 0 BEGIN SELECT TOP 1 @U_IM_ID = U_IM_ID FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND is_Default = 1 END SELECT @Price = PRICE,@Price_2 = Min_SP,@Price_3 = Min_SP_2,@OFFER_PRICE = OFFER_PRICE ,@U_ID = U_ID,@U_Cargo = U_Cargo , @Cost = Cost FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_IM_ID = @U_IM_ID SELECT @ST_QTY = (U_Cargo * @QYT) FROM Units WHERE U_ID = @U_ID
IF @SALES_TYPES = 1 BEGIN SET @Price = @Price_2 SET @is_By_Min_SP = 1 END IF @SALES_TYPES = 2 BEGIN SET @Price = @Price_3 SET @is_By_Min_SP_2 = 1 END
IF @IM_Price IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @Price = @IM_Price END
select @Bercent = Percent_Price from Change_Price WHERE GM_ID = (SELECT GM_ID FROM IM_Menu WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID ) IF @Bercent IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @NOTES = @Bercent SET @Price += @Price * (@Bercent / 100) END
IF @QYT = 0 BEGIN SET @QYT = 1 END EXEC [Check_IM_OFFER] @IM_ID,@Price OUTPUT,@OFFER_PRICE
EXEC @T_ID = [AA_GET_MAX_SB_Contents]
INSERT INTO SB_Contents (T_ID,Bill_T_ID,IM_ID,U_ID,ST_ID,Date,Compons,Cost,Price,D_Vaild,QTY,T_Price,U_Cargo,ST_QTY,isDepended,Notes,Barcode,is_By_Min_SP,is_By_Min_SP_2) VALUES(@T_ID,@SB_T_ID,@IM_ID,@U_ID,@ST_ID,GETDATE(),NULL,(@Cost * @U_Cargo),@Price,@Valid_ST,@QYT,(@Price * @QYT),@U_Cargo,@ST_QTY,1,@NOTES,@Barcode,@is_By_Min_SP,@is_By_Min_SP_2)
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN EXEC [SB_Contents_Structers_insert_ONE] @T_ID --UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
IF (SELECT ISNULL(S_Bills_Type,1) FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID) = 3 BEGIN UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 0 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID --EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,@ST_QTY END
--EXEC SB_Contents_UPDATE_ST_PERCENT @T_ID,@ST_ID
--COMMIT --END TRY
--BEGIN CATCH --IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 --raiserror('[SB_Contents_INSERT]',16,1,'خطأ') --ROLLBACK --END CATCH
exec Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @SB_T_ID
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 DECLARE @ERR_STR NVARCHAR(MAX) SET @ERR_STR = '[SB_Contents_INSERT] ' + ERROR_MESSAGE() raiserror(@ERR_STR,16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_Contents_INSERT_2] @SB_T_ID int, @IM_ID int, @D_Vaild DATE = NULL, @QYT float = 1, @U_ID int, @ST_ID int, @Price FLOAT, @On_Update Bit, @Current_QTY Float = NULL, @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL, @Barcode NVARCHAR(100) = NULL, @Serial_Code NVARCHAR(100) = '', @is_By_Min_SP int = 0 , @is_By_Min_SP_2 int = 0, @SB_IM_NEW_ROW bit = 1
AS
DECLARE @T_ID int, @U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@Cost Float,@ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,2),@Valid_ST NVARCHAR(50) ,@Total Numeric(18,3),@AG_ID int,@Markter_Val Numeric(18,3),@OFFER_PRICE Numeric(18,3),@LAST_T_ID INT
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
SET @Valid_ST = @D_Vaild
IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST ='' END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @Current_QTY = ISNULL(SUM(QTY),0) FROM ST_Balance_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID IF @Current_QTY <= 0 BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = (SELECT Top 1 D_Vaild FROM SB_Contents WHERE ST_ID = @ST_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID ORDER BY T_ID DESC) END --IF @Valid_ST IS NULL BEGIN SET @Valid_ST = '01-01-1900' END END
SELECT @U_Cargo = U_Cargo , @Cost = Cost , @Markter_Val = Markter_Val , @OFFER_PRICE = OFFER_PRICE FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_ID = @U_ID
IF (SELECT Markter_ID FROM SB_Info_V WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID) IN( 1 , NULL) BEGIN SET @Markter_Val = 0 END
SELECT @ST_QTY = (@U_Cargo * @QYT)
IF @QYT = 0 BEGIN SET @QYT = 1 END
EXEC @T_ID = [AA_GET_MAX_SB_Contents]
EXEC [Check_IM_OFFER] @IM_ID,@Price OUTPUT,@OFFER_PRICE
IF @SB_IM_NEW_ROW = 1 BEGIN
INSERT INTO SB_Contents (T_ID,Bill_T_ID,IM_ID,U_ID,ST_ID,Date,Compons,Cost,Price,D_Vaild,QTY,T_Price,U_Cargo,ST_QTY,isDepended,Notes,Markter_Val,Barcode,Serial_Code,is_By_Min_SP,is_By_Min_SP_2,is_Check) VALUES(@T_ID,@SB_T_ID,@IM_ID,@U_ID,@ST_ID,GETDATE(),NULL,(@Cost * @U_Cargo),@Price,@Valid_ST,@QYT,(@Price * @QYT),@U_Cargo,@ST_QTY,1,@Notes,@Markter_Val,@Barcode,@Serial_Code,@is_By_Min_SP,@is_By_Min_SP_2,1)
END ELSE IF (SELECT T_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @SB_T_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_ID = @U_ID AND Barcode = @Barcode AND Cost = @Cost AND D_Vaild = @Valid_ST AND Price = @Price AND U_Cargo = @U_Cargo ) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
SELECT @LAST_T_ID = T_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @SB_T_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_ID = @U_ID AND Barcode = @Barcode AND Cost = @Cost AND D_Vaild = @Valid_ST AND Price = @Price AND U_Cargo = @U_Cargo
UPDATE SB_Contents SET QTY += @QYT , ST_QTY = ST_QTY + (@QYT * @U_Cargo) , T_Price = ((QTY+@QYT) * Price) WHERE T_ID = @LAST_T_ID END ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO SB_Contents (T_ID,Bill_T_ID,IM_ID,U_ID,ST_ID,Date,Compons,Cost,Price,D_Vaild,QTY,T_Price,U_Cargo,ST_QTY,isDepended,Notes,Markter_Val,Barcode,Serial_Code,is_By_Min_SP,is_By_Min_SP_2,is_Check) VALUES(@T_ID,@SB_T_ID,@IM_ID,@U_ID,@ST_ID,GETDATE(),NULL,(@Cost * @U_Cargo),@Price,@Valid_ST,@QYT,(@Price * @QYT),@U_Cargo,@ST_QTY,1,@Notes,@Markter_Val,@Barcode,@Serial_Code,@is_By_Min_SP,@is_By_Min_SP_2,1)
END
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN --UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 1 WHERE T_ID = @T_ID EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
--EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,@ST_QTY --EXEC SB_Contents_UPDATE_ST_PERCENT @T_ID,@ST_ID
exec Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @SB_T_ID
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 DECLARE @ERR_STR NVARCHAR(MAX) SET @ERR_STR = ' [SB_Contents_INSERT_2] ' + ERROR_MESSAGE() raiserror(@ERR_STR,16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH
